title: mechanical close flow: close hook, stack bead, sanity-stack, runs tabs
description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bj`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bj` holds only this plan. The rulings are Rand's of 2026-10-18, anchored as ANC-051..074 in `docs/plans/phase-bj/anchors.md` (ANC-062 retired by ANC-065); the requirement docs are `docs/requirements/task-close-hook.md` and `docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md` of atm-bd-orchestration PR #342 with the dev, dev-sanity, team-lead and quality-mgr requirement items they amend.

## Goal
Dev work is not complete until sanity verifies it, and nothing between a dev push and the QA assignment needs the lead:
- one script, `atm-task-close.py --role <dev|fix|sanity|qa> --vars <file>`, is the only way a dev, fix, sanity or qa task completes; it checks the minimum, closes the bead, reports to the lead and assigns the next bead as the phase lead (ANC-051..059, ANC-070);
- the dev's ATM task stays open until the sanity close hook closes it on PASS; a sanity FAIL is one `sanity-fail.xml.j2` message to the dev on that open task, no finding children, counted in `metadata.sanity_round` up to `max_sanity_rounds` (default 5) (ANC-055..057, ANC-072);
- the stack bead `<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack` is the ledger and the lock of the phase stack; the sanity side links the layer on PASS under its claim, first PASS wins the top and the other dev gets `rebase-required` without a round counted; a sanity-stack subagent handles one next-top layer per spawn, sequentially, with a lean mode and a lock timeout that never blocks the team and never escalates to a person (ANC-065..069, ANC-071);
- the pour writes branch, worktree, pr_target and difficulty onto every bead of a sprint family and one pydantic validation covers every bead of the phase (ANC-063, atm-bd-orchestration #340);
- the console shows a sanity runs tab and a quality runs tab, newest first, per-reviewer verdict and elapsed, the dev's name and icon, and an API_FAILURE kind distinct from a FAIL verdict (ANC-073, ANC-074, atm-bd-orchestration #347).

Dev and fix assignment stay the lead's (ANC-060); atm-bd assigns only a sanity or qa bead that `bd ready` lists with no ATM task (ANC-061). The atm-core task-transition hook (ANC-064, atm-core #1873) is not in this phase: Rand is still settling its API, and `atm-task-close.py` stands in for it until it ships.

## Sprints
| Sprint | Title | Relation | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| bj-1 | close hook: atm-task-close.py roles dev, fix, sanity, qa; task-close-vars.j2, sanity-fail.xml.j2, rebase-required.xml.j2; max_sanity_rounds | root | - |
| bj-2 | stack bead and sprint-family pour: stack-bead.json.j2, pour metadata, pydantic model per bead kind, validate-plan | root | - |
| bj-3 | sanity-stack subagent and dev-sanity PASS wiring: sequential spawns, lock timeout, lean mode | must_follow | bj-1, bj-2 |
| bj-4 | console sanity and quality runs tabs; measured elapsed and dev identity in the sanity ledger | parallel_safe | - |

`requirements` and `adrs` are `NONE` on every sprint: the atm-core requirement and ADR documents do not govern atm-bd-orchestration code; the governing text is the package's `docs/requirements/*.md` named per sprint.

One boundary: the `plugins/atm-bd-orchestration` package (skills `atm-bd-orchestration` and `atm-beads`, `agents/`) plus the console app `apps/atm-bd-console` it ships.

## Decisions
- The hook is a script the agent runs as the last step of its template, not an atm-core hook: ANC-064's daemon hook waits on Rand's API ruling (atm-core #1873) and is out of this phase.
- The stack bead is poured with the phase root from a template, never created by hand; `validate-plan` requires it (team-lead 13).
- The sanity side links; the lead never links. The lead owns unstack, sync, rebase, merge and every `stack_failed`, always under the stack bead claim (team-lead 42).
- Nothing is a new process artifact: no class beads, outage beads, holds, refusal citations or checker-defect channel (ANC-074); the sanity run table template is retired by the runs tab.
acceptance_criteria:
## Success Criteria
- A dev bead closed through `atm-task-close.py --role dev` in a scratch repository leaves the dev's ATM task open, closes the bead, and assigns the sanity task as the phase lead with no lead action (ANC-052, ANC-055).
- A sanity PASS through the hook closes the dev's task as the lead and assigns QA as the lead; a sanity FAIL sends one `sanity-fail` message on the dev's open task and creates no bead (ANC-053, ANC-056, ANC-072).
- Two branches cut from the same top that both pass sanity: the first is linked as the new top in the stack bead's `layers`, the second gets `rebase-required` and `sanity_round` does not move (ANC-065, ANC-067, ANC-071).
- `validate-plan --phase bj` requires the stack bead and every poured sanity and qa bead carries branch, worktree, pr_target and difficulty (ANC-063).
- `atm-bd console` shows the sanity and quality tabs with per-reviewer verdict and elapsed, the dev's icon and name, and an API_FAILURE icon distinct from FAIL (ANC-073, ANC-074).
- Every sprint's QA PASS at its head; the stack lands on `integrate/phase-bj` of atm-bd-orchestration; `just lint` and `just test` green there.
